tools.name: list_queues
tools.description: List all support queues the authenticated user has access to. modules says which optional features each queue has turned on: knowledge base (kb), inventory (assets, needs the manage_assets permission too), statuses, categories, customers, custom fields, ticket templates, subtickets, participants and due dates. Tools for a feature a queue lacks answer with an error.

tools.name: list_statuses
tools.description: List the statuses tickets in a queue can have, for the status filter of list_tickets. rule says which event sets the status automatically (new_ticket, customer_to_int, int_to_customer, closing_ticket). Empty when the queue does not use statuses.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories in a queue, for the category filter of list_tickets. Categories can nest: parent is the category above and path the full name, e.g. "Hardware > Printers".

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List the customers in a queue, for the customer filter of list_tickets. Customers can nest: parent is the customer above and path the full name.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the agents tickets in a queue can be assigned to, for the owner filter of list_tickets

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets in a queue, 50 per page by default. Without closed or search: open tickets that are not hidden. A search (search or content) without closed covers open, closed and hidden tickets alike; with closed it keeps to the closed (true) or open (false) ones. Each ticket includes its priority, status, owner, category, customer and a link to its page in the web UI. Use list_queues for queue IDs and list_statuses, list_categories, list_customers or list_agents for the filter IDs.

closed.description: true for closed tickets, false for open ones

search.description: Search term matched against subject and submitter email

content.description: Text to find in any of the ticket's messages: description, replies and internal notes. Follows closed like search does.

status.description: Only tickets with this status ID

owner.description: Only tickets owned by this user ID, "me" for your own tickets, or "none" for unassigned tickets

category.description: Only tickets in this category ID

customer.description: Only tickets for this customer ID

created_from.description: Only tickets created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

created_to.description: Only tickets created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get full details of a single ticket: description, priority, status, owner, category, customer, queue, due date, participants, parent ticket, subtickets, related tickets, custom fields, template answers and a link to the web UI. For replies and changes, use get_ticket_history.

tools.name: get_ticket_history
tools.description: Get everything that happened on a ticket after it was created, oldest first: replies, internal notes (internal=true) and changes such as status, owner, category or closing (type=change, author null when the system made it). The description is not included; use get_ticket for that.

format.description: Format of message bodies and system notes (default: text)

include_quoted.description: Include the quoted part of mail replies, which mostly repeats earlier messages (default: false)

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List ticket templates available in a queue

tools.name: list_asset_tables
tools.description: List the inventory tables in a queue (e.g. computers, phones, licenses), with the fields each table has

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List the inventory items in an inventory table. Supports search over the items' field values and pagination.

search.description: Search term matched against the items' field values

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Get a single inventory item with all its field values and the tickets linked to it

tools.name: get_asset_history
tools.description: Get the change history of an inventory item: field changes and tickets being linked or unlinked

tools.name: search_kb_articles
tools.description: List or search the knowledge base articles of a queue, best matches first when searching. Includes internal articles. visibility is public (anyone), portal (signed-in portal users) or internal (agents only) — check it before quoting an article to a customer.

search.description: Search words matched against the article's title, question and answer

category.description: Only articles in this knowledge base category ID

tools.name: get_kb_article
tools.description: Get a knowledge base article: question, answer, category, visibility, who wrote and last changed it, and its attached files

format.description: Format of the question and answer (default: text)
